content: Sɑɑ yè sɔɔ Roboɑmu u tunumɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, yerɑ u Yudɑbɑ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ kpuro mɛnnɑ, mɑ u be sɔɔ tɑbu durɔ dɑmɡibu nɔrɔbun subɑ wunɔbu kɑ wɛnɛ (180.000) ɡɔsɑ bu dɑ bu Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri wɔku te wɔri kpɑ bu bɑn te wɔrɑmɑ bu nùn wesiɑ.
Adɑmɑ Gusunɔ u kɑ win sɔmɔ Semɑyɑ ɡɑri kuɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ Roboɑmu, Sɑlomɔɔn bii, Yudɑbɑn sunɔ kɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ,

wee ye nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, bu ku rɑɑ dɑ bu kɑ ben mɛro bisibu Isirelibɑ tɑbu ko. Ben bɑɑwure u ɡɔsiro win yɛnuɔ. Domi yeni yɑ nɑwɑ sɑɑ nɛn min di. Mɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡere wurɑ, bɑ ɡɔsirɑ bɑ wurɑ ben yɛnusɔ.
Roboɑmu
u wusu ɡbɑ̃rɑnu bɑnisi
Roboɑmu u dɑ u sinɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Mɑ u Yudɑn wusu ɡbɑ̃rɑnu bɑnisi.
U Bɛtelehɛmu bɑnɑ, kɑ Etɑmu kɑ Tekoɑ
kɑ Bɛti Suri kɑ Soko kɑ Adulɑmu
kɑ Gɑti kɑ Mɑresɑ kɑ Sifu
kɑ Adorɑimu kɑ Lɑkisi kɑ Asekɑ
kɑ Soreɑ kɑ Ayɑloni kɑ Heboroni. Wuu si, su wɑ̃ɑwɑ Yudɑn temɔ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn temɔ. Mɑ u su tɑ̃sisiɑ.
U su ɡbɑ̃rɑnu toosi, mɑ u tɑbu sinɑmbu yi yi mi. Mɑ u diɑ kuɑ mi bɑ ko n dɑ dĩɑnu kɑ ɡum kɑ tɑm bere.
U wuu sin bɑɑɡere sɔɔ tɛrɛnu kɑ yɑɑsi yi. Mɑ u su tɑ̃sisiɑ. Mɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ bɑ kɑ nùn yɔ̃rɑ.
Yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑ
bɑ wurɑ Roboɑmun mi ɡiɑ
Yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefi be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn tem sɔɔ kpuro, bɑ seewɑ ben wɑ̃ɑ yerun di bɑ nɑ Roboɑmun mi.
Lefibɑ bɑ ben wɑ̃ɑ yenu deri mɑ bɑ nɑ Yudɑɔ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ yèn sɔ̃ Yeroboɑmu kɑ win bibu bɑ bu yinɑri bu ben yɑ̃ku kowo sɔmɑ ko.
Yeroboɑmu u yɑ̃ku kowobu yi yi win bwɑ̃ɑrokunun sɔ̃, ni u kuɑ nu kɑ boo kinɛnu kɑ kɛtɛbɑ weenɛ.
Isireli be bɑ tie bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑrun kĩru mɔ, bɑ Lefibɑ swĩi Yerusɑlɛmuɔ bu kɑ Gusunɔ ben bɑɑbɑbɑn Yinni yɑ̃kuru kuɑ.
Mɑ bɑ Yudɑn bɑndun dɑm sire, bɑ Roboɑmu, Sɑlomɔɔn bii tɑ̃sisiɑ wɔ̃ɔ itɑ. Wɔ̃ɔ itɑ ye sɔɔrɑ bɑ sĩɑ Dɑfidi kɑ Sɑlomɔɔn yirɑ sɔɔ.
Roboɑmun bweseru
Roboɑmu u Mɑhɑlɑti suɑ kurɔ. Mɑhɑlɑtin tundon yĩsirɑ Yerimɔti, Dɑfidin bii. Win mɛron yĩsirɑ Abihɑili, Eliɑbun bii, Isɑin debubu.
Mɑhɑlɑti wi, u bii tɔn durɔbu mɑrɑ. Berɑ Yeusi kɑ Semɑriɑ kɑ Sɑhɑmu.
Mɑhɑlɑtin biru, u Mɑɑkɑ suɑ kurɔ. Mɑɑkɑ wi, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Abusɑlɔmun bii. Mɑ u Roboɑmu Abiɑ kɑ Atɑi mɑruɑ kɑ mɑɑ Sisɑ kɑ Selomiti.
Roboɑmu u Mɑɑkɑ kĩ too n kere win kurɔ be bɑ tie. Domi kurɔbu yɛndu yiru sɑriwɑ u sue yɛnuɔ mɑ u mɑɑ kurɔ tɑnɔbu mɔ wɑtɑ tɔɔwɔ. Bii tɔn durɔbu tɛnɑ yiru sɑriwɑ u mɑrɑ. Bii tɔn kurɔbu mɑɑ wɑtɑ.
Roboɑmu u Abiɑ, Mɑɑkɑn bii yerumɑru wɛ̃. Mɑ u nùn kuɑ win mɑɑbu kɑ win wɔnɔbun ɡuro ɡuro. Domi u kĩ u nùn ko sunɔ.
Yen biru, u win bii be bɑ tie yɑrinɑsiɑ kɑ bwisi. U derɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn wuu ɡbɑ̃rɑnuɡisu sɔɔ. U bu dĩɑnu wɛ̃ nu kpɑ̃. Mɑ u mɑɑ bu kurɔ dɑbinu suɑ.
